prompt: Das Design für 002 ist fertig. Setz es um.
assertions: Work happens on a feature branch for 002, not on main
A date module implements the R4 boundary with a strict comparison: a task due today is due-today, not overdue
Unit tests cover both sides of the R4 boundary (yesterday overdue, today not overdue)
R5 is enforced: a malformed date and a non-existent day such as 2026-02-30 are rejected with a message about the date
POST accepts an optional dueDate and PATCH can set a day on a task that had none (S5.1-S5.3)
GET /api/tasks returns a dueState for every task (S6.1-S6.4)
The list order keeps done tasks below open ones and orders by day inside each group, undated last (S6.5 plus 001 S3.2)
The overdue marking carries a word, not only a colour (QE6)
Title and marking are at least 20 px on a phone viewport (QE5)
The add form stays one line of inputs and one button (QE7)
Recurring tasks are not built: no repeat field, no repeat UI, no stored repeat value
No reminders, notifications or outbound mail were built
docs/implementation/002-due-dates.md exists and its claims carry command evidence (commands and their observed output, not assertions of success)
The requirements status is set to 'Implemented - ready for validation' and docs/product.md shows 002 as Implemented
Requirements and design documents are unchanged apart from status lines
tests/acceptance/ is untouched: the implementer added no acceptance tests and edited none
The unit suite passes and no test was skipped, disabled or deleted to get there
The self-validation actually ran the stack: the report shows docker compose up, HTTP calls against the running product, and a restart that kept the data
No question was asked to the user or the stakeholder
